mapper.update: UPDATE job_posting SET title=#{title}, description=#{description}, pay=#{pay}, pay_type=#{payType}, work_period=#{workPeriod}, work_days=#{workDays}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, time_negotiable=#{timeNegotiable}, location=#{location}, contact=#{contact}, benefits=#{benefits}, category=#{category} WHERE posting_idx = #{postingIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM rnum FROM ( SELECT posting_idx AS postingIdx, title, employer, pay, pay_type AS payType, location, createdDate, category, work_period AS workPeriod, work_days AS workDays, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime FROM job_posting ORDER BY posting_idx DESC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{size} ) WHERE rnum > #{offset}
